observations.body: Promise rests on faith and God’s life-giving power. For the promise to Abraham and to his offspring that he would be heir of the world wasn’t through the law, but through the righteousness of faith. who was delivered up for our trespasses, and was raised for our justification.

payload.posture: Read Romans 4:13–25 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states promise rests on faith and God’s life-giving power. For the promise to Abraham and to his offspring that he would be heir of the world wasn’t through the law, but through the righteousness of faith. who was delivered up for our trespasses, and was raised for our justification. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
